question: Each of the six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U has different height. P is the tallest person. R is taller than only one other person. S is taller than U. U is taller than R. Exactly three persons have height between T and Q, while T is taller than Q. Who is the shortest among all the six persons?
solution:
Given: Six people P, Q, R, S, T, and U are comparing their heights.

No two people are of the same height.

1) P is the tallest person.

2) R is taller than only one other person.

P > __ > __ > __ > R > __

3) U is taller than R.</sp
